modules.title: 多个近似地址怎样汇聚到一个代表版本
Canonical URL 怎样发挥作用

items.title: 页面声明自己偏好的代表地址
items.text: 带参数或其他重复入口的页面可以在 head 中通过 rel=canonical 指向更希望被识别的 URL；这是给搜索系统的规范化提示。

items.title: 访问地址和代表地址可以暂时不同
items.text: 用户仍可能打开带参数的当前 URL，地址栏通常不会因为 canonical 自动改变；Sitemap 也应与选定的代表版本保持一致。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Canonical 是告诉搜索系统哪个 URL 更像代表版本的提示；Redirect 是把访问从旧 URL 带到新 URL 的机制。前者通常不改地址栏，也不是强制命令；需要用户离开旧地址时，应配置重定向。

lessonPractice.title: 旧商品地址还需要让用户自动到新地址，不能继续停留在旧地址。应该使用什么？

options.label: 配置从旧地址到新地址的重定向，并检查地址栏已经改变
options.feedback: 对。用户必须被带到新地址时，需要重定向并验证最终 URL；canonical 本身通常不会改变地址栏。

options.label: 只在旧页面 head 里加入指向新地址的 canonical
options.feedback: Canonical 是代表版本提示，旧地址通常仍可访问；它不能单独满足自动迁移访问的要求。

options.label: 删除旧页面并让它显示一个找不到页面
options.feedback: 删除旧地址会造成 404，既没有把用户送到新内容，也没有保留旧链接的迁移关系。

en.title: Visitors must automatically reach the new product URL instead of staying on the old one. What should be used?

options.label: Configure a redirect from the old URL to the new one and check that the address bar changes
options.feedback: Correct. When visitors must reach a new address, use and verify a redirect; a canonical hint normally does not change the address bar.

options.label: Add only a canonical link to the new URL in the old page head
options.feedback: A canonical is a preferred-version hint, and the old URL usually remains accessible. It does not by itself migrate visitors.

options.label: Delete the old page and let it show a not-found page
options.feedback: Deleting the old URL creates a 404 without sending visitors to the new content or preserving a migration relationship.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让商品参数页的 head 声明无参数主地址为 canonical，并让 sitemap.xml 只列这个主地址。逐个检查参数页的 canonical、Sitemap 清单和浏览器地址栏，确认参数页不会因为 canonical 自动跳转。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Set the no-parameter product URL as the canonical in the head of parameterized pages, and list only that main URL in sitemap.xml. Check each page's canonical, the sitemap list, and the browser address bar to confirm that canonical does not automatically redirect the parameterized page.

references.title: 如何指定规范网址
references.title_en: How to specify a canonical URL

learning.assumes: You have seen product or article URLs with query parameters and know that a page can contain link metadata in its head.
learning.outcome: You can choose a representative URL and distinguish a canonical hint from a redirect that changes the address bar.

modules.title: How similar URLs converge on one representative version

items.title: A page declares its preferred representative
items.text: A page with parameters or another duplicate entry can use rel=canonical in its head to point to the URL it prefers search systems to recognize as representative.

items.title: The visited URL and representative can differ
items.text: People may still open the parameterized current URL, and the address bar normally does not change because of canonical. The sitemap should use the chosen representative too.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A canonical is a hint about which URL should represent a group to search systems. A redirect sends a visit from an old URL to a new one. Canonical usually does not change the address bar and is not a forced command; use a redirect when people must leave the old URL.
